attributes.board_name: Mississippi State Board of Medical Licensure

rules.accepted_credit_types: Category 1 from organizations approved by the Mississippi State Medical Association, AMA or ACCME; AOA Category 1-A; AAFP prescribed hours; ACOG cognates
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial Mississippi license (or first specialty board certification) after June 30: exempt for the current cycle; compliance due in the next cycle.
rules.alternatives: MD/DO must either keep an account with a Board-approved CME tracking system or hold active ABMS/AOA board certification (lifetime certification without maintenance does not count). Residents/fellows exempt (Policy 3.05). Waiver for legitimate cause if requested before April 1 of the cycle's last year.
rules.audit_note: Attest on every annual renewal in MELS; random compliance review. Since Feb 27, 2026 physicians no longer send CME documents to the Board; upload to the tracking system. Deficiencies must be fixed within 6 months.

topics.who: DEA-registered licensees: one-time training under §303 of the Controlled Substances Act (opioid or substance use disorder treatment)

rules.notes: One board licenses MDs and DOs. Annual license renewal; CME runs in two-year cycles from July 1 to June 30 (current cycle July 1, 2026 - June 30, 2028). Excess hours do not carry over.
rules.legal_basis: 30 Miss. Admin. Code Part 2610, Chapter 2, Rules 2.1-2.6
rules.rule_quote: 40 hours of Category 1 CME in each two-year cycle.
